 Alan Ritchson's latest crime thriller movie will be soaring onto Blu-ray in the new year. Motor City is getting the physical media treatment courtesy of IFC Films.

 New details have emerged via MovieWeb regarding Motor City's official Blu-ray release, which will hit shops in a little under two months on Jan. 12, 2027. The film was quietly released in theaters in the United States back in July, where its box office totals came in at $3 million against a $30 million budget. Ritchson stars as John Miller in Motor City , an ex-con who goes on a mission to get revenge against the gangster (Ben Foster) who framed him and his girlfriend (Shailene Woodley) back in 1977 Detroit.
 Alan Ritchson's Motor City Heads to Blu-ray Following Warm Audience Reception
 IFC Films' Blu-ray release for Potsy Ponciroli's Motor City features a 1080p HD transfer in the original 2:39 widescreen aspect ratio. It includes an English DTS-HD Master Audio 5.1 soundtrack — perfect for the film's minimal dialogue, which relied more heavily on a rock soundtrack and action scenes to keep the adrenaline pumping.
 Cover artwork for Motor City 's Blu-ray release hints that it will be a rather barebones release, with no special features or bonus material listed in the publisher details. The single disc Blu-ray will instead offer solely the film, which might be disappointing to those who have already watched it and were craving more.
 While Motor City' s theatrical run in the United States didn't pull in a massive box office haul, those who did see the film have largely enjoyed it . It has a 63% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes from nearly 100 critics' reviews, and a 64% audience score from over 250+ verified theatregoers.
 The Rotten Tomatoes consensus highlights the film's lack of dialogue, noting that it "occasionally backfires in a story that winds up running on fumes." Nonetheless, critics still admitted that the soundtrack and visual delight are able to "soup up the engine enough to deliver a memorable ride."
 While critics enjoyed the fresh twist on the action trope — which is right in Ritchson's wheelhouse — some real audience members found the lack of dialogue to be a frustration. "It would have been a much better movie if there was some dialogue," a 1-star review on Rotten Tomatoes reads.
 "If you don’t like dialogue, this one’s for you… pretty much a silent film," another 3.5-star reviewer added, indicating that the film's unique approach to its script wasn't all that bad. Another user highly agreed in their own 5-star review, saying: "This was fantastic! No dialogue, just a few words and a great soundtrack. The acting was phenomenal and it was action-packed from beginning to end. I highly recommend it!"
 Alan Ritchson is Currently Filming His Mike Thornton Biopic
 Alan Ritchson lights up a cigarette RLJE 
 Motor City may have seen Ritchson flexing his action prowess without much talking, but his other recent roles have been much more traditional in their approach. In 2026, he also starred in Netflix's hit military sci-fi flick War Machine , which quickly became one of the platform's most watched films of all time . He also appeared in the action comedy Runner from Scott Waugh and will end the year with the Christmas action movie The Man with the Bag alongside Arnold Schwarzenegger.
 In 2027, Ritchson already has an untitled Mike Thornton biopic film lined up, which he is also producing and writing. Ritchson stars in the main role, highlighting the life of the retired U.S. Navy SEAL who was awarded the Medal of Honor for his actions in the Vietnam War. Joe Cole ( Peaky Blinders ), Kyle Allen ( American Horror Story: Apocalypse ) and Kodi Smit-McPhee ( Dawn of the Planet of the Apes ) also star.
 Motor City heads to Blu-ray on Jan. 12, 2027.
